sets.label: Round 1 - 200 teacher games - 0% wins (30 held-out boards)
sets.notes: Round 1: one MBON type per action, dense KC code, 300 teacher-driven warm-start games then RL (checkpoint at 200 games). 0/30 held-out wins, 46.9 safe cells (docs/training.md section 3.5).

sets.label: Round 2 - 1,500 teacher games - 48% wins (100 held-out boards)
sets.notes: Round 2: 34 MBON types in six pools, sparse KC code (kc_bias -0.3, pn_bias -0.3, pn_kc_gain 3), perceptron warm start on 1,500 teacher games, reveal margin 0.25. 48/100 held-out wins, 66.7 +- 0.8 safe cells (docs/training.md section 4.1).

sets.label: Round 3 - 2,000 teacher games - 76% wins (100 held-out boards)
sets.notes: Direction channels strengthened (2 ORN types each), teacher phase continued from round 2 with argmax perceptron updates, reveal mask; RL fine-tune matched wins but doubled game length so the teacher checkpoint is installed.
